Guidelines

App Name Guidelines

Your app’s name plays a critical role in how users discover it on the App Store. Choose a simple, memorable name that is easy to spell and hints at what your app does. Be distinctive. Avoid names that use generic terms or are too similar to existing app names.

Learn more Learn more
Why isn't Feature Graphic shown on the Store?

1. Required Console Asset: Google Play Console mandates a 1024×500 px graphic (PNG/JPEG without alpha) before an app listing can be submitted or approved.

2. Store Listing Detail Page: Google removed the standalone banner from phone and desktop store listings to prioritize the App Icon, CTAs, and Screenshots directly.

3. YouTube Promo Video: If you provide a promo video URL, the Feature Graphic acts as the video cover thumbnail with a large play button.

4. Where It Actually Appears: Featured collections, Google Play Home / For You editorial banners, category recommendations, search ads, and Google App Campaigns.

Learn more
iOS App Icon & Xcode Guidelines

1. Xcode Packaging: Must be bundled inside Assets.xcassets (AppIcon) in your Xcode project before archiving.

2. Dimensions & Color: Exactly 1024 × 1024 px (1:1 square) in sRGB or Display P3.

3. No Transparency: Must be 100% opaque without alpha channel (transparency causes upload rejection).

4. Square Corners: Upload sharp square corners. iOS automatically applies the squircle mask (do not pre-round).

5. Design Standards: Avoid promotional text (Free, #1), device frames, or UI elements.

Learn more
Full Description Display Guidelines

1. Google Play Store: Only displays the Short Description (80 chars) on the main page. The Full Description appears on a separate screen when tapping About this app →.

2. Apple App Store: Displayed directly on the main page below screenshots, previewing the first 3 lines with a "more" expander.

3. ASO & SEO Indexing: On Google Play, the Full Description is the primary asset for search algorithm indexing and organic keyword ranking.

Learn more
Store Privacy & Data Safety Guidelines

1. Questionnaires on Store Consoles: Privacy disclosures cannot be freely edited as text. Developers must complete compliance questionnaires in App Store Connect and Google Play Console.

2. Apple Nutrition Labels: Discloses whether collected data is Linked to You, Not Linked, or used for Tracking.

3. Google Play Data Safety: Discloses third-party data sharing, encryption in transit, and account deletion options.

Learn more Learn more
What's New Display Guidelines

1. Apple App Store (Public Listing): Rendered directly on the main store page below screenshots, showing the version, release date, and release notes.

2. Google Play Store (Update State Only): Hidden on pre-install listings. Only visible to existing users downloading an app update.

3. Console Character Limits: Google Play caps release notes at 500 characters per language (App Store allows up to 4,000 characters).

Learn more
Mockup Metrics & Badges Guidelines

Not Storefront Listing Fields:

Ratings, review counts, category chart ranks, download volume tiers (50K+), age ratings, and in-app purchase tags are dynamically calculated by Apple and Google store algorithms or generated from developer questionnaires.

They cannot be edited or submitted as store listing metadata.

Store Review Disclaimer

Validation checks help catch mechanical formatting mistakes (such as incorrect dimensions, transparent alpha channels on iOS, or file size limits).

However, passing these checks does not guarantee store approval — final acceptance is decided solely by Apple and Google review teams based on your complete submission and store guidelines.
